title: Choose the visual world
question: Which world should shape Edres's personal, Arabic-first portfolio? Choose one, re-roll, or take the familiar category standard.

options.label: The Referral Card
options.lineage: a personal calling card passed hand to hand, then opened into a working folio
options.thesis: The portfolio feels like Edres handed the visitor his own card, with every claim backed on the reverse.
options.viewport: One edge-to-edge calling card: Edres's Arabic name leads, the service promise and WhatsApp action stay immediately visible, and proof sits on clipped edge tabs.
options.risk: The stationery metaphor can delay service clarity unless the offer and WhatsApp action remain explicit in the first view.

raised.raise: Every section now joins the next with visible numbering and exact alignment.
After-launch care is shown as a sequence of maintained states, not left as a claim.
Proof attaches directly to the sentence it supports through precise callouts.
A fixed symbol family and fully committed palette make the whole folio unmistakably one person's.
Available, coming-soon, active, and secondary states remain unmistakable at a glance.

options.label: The Teaching Board
options.lineage: a teacher's demonstration board with a lesson, worked example, and concise annotations
options.thesis: Edres earns trust by explaining a durable website the way a good teacher makes a difficult idea feel obvious.
options.viewport: A single oversized teaching board: the headline is the lesson, three factual proof notes point into it, and WhatsApp is the only solid marker block.
options.risk: It can resemble an education product if the web-development offer is not dominant enough.

options.label: Pattern Before Cut
options.lineage: a home sewing pattern envelope and its folded tissue map
options.thesis: A reliable website is composed like a pattern: planned, numbered, aligned, and checked before the irreversible cut.
options.viewport: The headline sits on a full-width pattern piece while numbered service pieces lock around it; WhatsApp is the single solid cut line.
options.case: Product clarity is strong because the system visibly demonstrates planning and fit; personal identification is weaker than the card or teaching board.
options.risk: The construction metaphor may require one extra beat of interpretation for a business owner.

options.label: Personal Riso Print
options.lineage: a two-ink risograph print with deliberate misregistration and grain
options.thesis: Edres's name, proof, services, and invitation become four bold ink plates that only make the full picture when aligned.
options.viewport: A typographic first view layers the Arabic name over the durability promise, with one fluorescent WhatsApp block and a visible slice of the work below.
options.case: It creates a memorable asset-free personal voice and keeps the offer legible; it identifies less directly with conservative referral clients.
options.risk: The print energy can read as playful rather than dependable if the information grid loosens.

options.label: Maintained States
options.lineage: a kiln shelf tracking glaze from dry coat to arrested flow
options.thesis: Each website is shown through the states that keep it healthy after launch.
options.viewport: A row of three maintained states frames the durability promise and ends at the WhatsApp action.
options.case: It proves maintenance vividly but does not feel personally or culturally close to this audience.
options.kept: The selected direction inherits visible before, stable, and maintained states.
options.risk: The pottery world would overpower Edres's actual identity.

options.label: Rules in the Margin
options.lineage: a coded uniform document with measured modifications and leader-line rules
options.thesis: Every promise is annotated with the exact rule or fact that makes it credible.
options.viewport: The offer appears as a measured central composition, with factual callouts and WhatsApp pinned at the edge.
options.case: The annotation logic is excellent, but the source culture does not identify with Edres or his Saudi clients.
options.kept: The selected direction inherits callouts that bind every proof point to its claim.
options.risk: The source association is unrelated and would feel imported.

options.label: Signed Symbol Plate
options.lineage: a collective's hard-edged painted plate and fixed symbol vocabulary
options.thesis: A small set of symbols becomes Edres's unmistakable signature across every section.
options.viewport: A hovering symbol field surrounds the name and offer while one grounded symbol carries WhatsApp.
options.case: It is visually personal but makes the service and evidence less immediate than the assigned direction.
options.kept: The selected direction inherits a disciplined fixed palette and repeatable symbol family.
options.risk: Abstract symbols could become decoration without adding trust.

options.label: Always-On Status
options.lineage: seven-segment clocks, scoreboards, and price totems
options.thesis: Availability, maintenance, and project status occupy fixed cells whose state is always legible.
options.viewport: A rigid status mask makes the durability promise enormous, with the current project and WhatsApp held in fixed slots.
options.case: Status clarity is high, but the instrument language suppresses the personal warmth the user asked to lead with.
options.kept: The selected direction inherits unmistakable active, inactive, and coming-soon states.
options.risk: It would feel more like a dashboard than a personal portfolio.

canonCard.label: The polished developer portfolio
canonCard.thesis: A dark neutral grid, oversized name, compact project list, and familiar blue action executed at a high craft level.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role fill the left half, the promise and WhatsApp action sit on the right, and selected work begins below the fold.
canonCard.risk: It is easy to trust and easy to forget because it resembles thousands of developer portfolios.
